title: The canonical open map is invertible on finite-Tor inputs
statement: Under exactly the field, scheme and morphism hypotheses of lem-sf-ring-open-refinement, let s be a finite or completed integral ring stage, r:c→d a compactification refinement, hi its coefficient composition identification, and K an object of the full finite-Tor stage category. The component of the explicit ambient transformation refinementOpenMap of lem-sf-refinement-open-restriction at the underlying object of K is invertible. This is only a pointwise invertibility assertion for an already constructed map. It contains no natural-isomorphism choice, no proper pushforward word and no shift assertion.

source.place: Tags 0F7B and 0F7I, the restriction-to-open and proper base-change proof; completed coefficient transport as in Zheng Section 5, 5.13--5.15.

proof.text: For finite coefficients the canonical map restricts to an isomorphism on X by its inverse-restriction construction. The finite-Tor input is bounded constructible and of etale origin. Proper base change makes the map between the two zero restrictions on the complement an isomorphism. Open-closed detection gives invertibility of its cone, hence of the canonical map. The canonical coefficient realization preserves the open units, pullback composition and proper counit.

For integral coefficients use the same open-unit/counit word in the normalized strict system of a finite-Tor input. Every finite evaluation is invertible by the preceding case. Conservative evaluations imply invertibility in the system derived category. Total limit preserves this isomorphism. Primitive open/proper realization and its generator normalization identify it with refinementOpenMap, including its transpose. This uses actual system maps, never equality detection by reductions.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0F7B and 0F7I, extracted from lem-sf-ring-open-refinement steps 1--3.

theorem ringOpenMap_isIso
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{max u v}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    {X Y : Scheme.{max u v}} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    {c d : Compactification f} (r : c.Refinement d) (s : RingStage.{max u v} l)
    (hi : (s.coefficients l).pull (c.i ≫ r.hom) =
      proEtaleRingCompositeCoefficients c.i r.hom
        ((s.coefficients l).ring d.Z) ((s.coefficients l).ring c.Z)
        ((s.coefficients l).ring X)
        ((s.coefficients l).pull r.hom) ((s.coefficients l).pull c.i))
    (K : C.{u, v} l Ω X (s.stage l)) :
    IsIso ((PurCompactSupport.refinementOpenMap (s.coefficients l) r hi).app
      ((RingStage.inclusion.{u, v} l Ω X s).obj K))
